description: Privacy-first operations browser for security and network administrators. Cookies are blocked unless a site is explicitly allowed, trackers are filtered, and the browsing profile stays in memory. Installs per-machine to Program Files with an HKLM uninstall entry.
notes: Requirements: Windows 10 or later, x64. Electron 45 documents support for 'Windows 10 and up' and ships x64 binaries; no narrower build floor is claimed here because Electron does not document one. Detection reads the file version of %ProgramFiles%\WARDEN\WARDEN.exe rather than the uninstall DisplayName, which embeds the version and would break every release. The installer is unsigned, so SmartScreen may prompt on a first interactive launch; unattended installs are unaffected. Uninstall removes profile data (settings, allowlists, history) for all local profiles; add -KeepUserData to the uninstall command line to retain it. Installing per-machine requires the SYSTEM context this app uses; a per-user install under SYSTEM would land in the SYSTEM profile and is refused by the deploy script by design.
